CREATE VIEW [EDS].[PBI_VIEW_CBC01_DEPOSIT_FACT]
AS SELECT A.CUST_ID,
A.GAM_ACID ACID,
A.FORACID [Account ID],
A.ACCT_NAME [Account Name] ,
--B.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE [Account Holder Type],
'TBD' [Account Holder Type],
'TBD' [Account Status],
'TBD' [Profit Cost Code],
A.SOL_ID [Branch Code],
'TBD' Area,
'TBD' Region,
A.GAM_SCHM_CODE [Product ID],
'TBD' [Product Group],
'TBD' [Product Name],
A.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE [Original Currency],
A.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE [Deposit OS Bal Original],
A.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP [Deposit OS Bal PHP],
A.YEAR_TO_DATE_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE [YTD ABD Original],
A.YEAR_TO_DATE_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE_PHP [YTD ADB PHP],
A.AS_OF_DATE [As of Date]
FROM EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT A
--LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM BUSC.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP WHERE ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE IN ('M','J') AND DEL_FLG <> 'Y' AND BANK_ID = 'CBC01')  B ON B.ACID = A.GAM_ACID AND B.CUST_ID = A.CUST_ID
--INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(AS_OF_DATE) MAX_DATE FROM EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT ) MAXDATE ON MAXDATE.MAX_DATE = A.AS_OF_DATE
WHERE Convert(CHAR(8),AS_OF_DATE,112)   = 20230801  AND A.GAM_BANK_ID = 'CBC01';
GO
